baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ء م ن forms at words 2 and 4 lead through ثم لم يرتابوا and the paired instruments بأموالهم وأنفسهم to هم الصادقون.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled assent is exposed to disturbing doubt, then confirmed by spending both owned resources and the living self at the limit of capacity along God's route. Truth is therefore correspondence enacted under cost, not a second verbal claim.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust supply the stable inward condition that the following clauses test.
Trusting assent supplies the initial confirmation that later conduct must make durable.
Disturbing doubt and suspicion name the destabilizing pressure that does not dislodge assent.
Capacity spent under strain turns inward confidence into costly exertion.
Acquired wealth supplies the alienable outer reserve placed into the exertion.
The living soul-self supplies the non-alienable inner stake paired with property.
An extended traversed way gives the expenditure direction rather than making cost an end in itself.
Fulfillment in action makes the final truth predicate the realized confirmation of the opening assent.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists correct belief, absence of doubt, and sacrifice as traits of believers.
changed_reading.after: The ayah traces a verification circuit: settled assent survives destabilization and becomes truthful by converting both property and living self into directed action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The delayed connector ثم and negated يرتابوا stand between initial assent and sustained exertion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The time-and-death branch of ريب makes the middle clause a durability test across later reversals, while the traversed way and fulfillment branches make truth a maintained course. The sequence measures continuity, not the intensity of an inaugural moment.

activation_trace.role: Settled security supplies the state whose persistence is being measured.
Uncertain turns of time and death give ثم a field of intervening reversals through which trust persists.
Continued expenditure of capacity shows endurance after the interval rather than a momentary profession.
A traversed route supplies extension through time and a course that must be kept.
Solidity and straightness make truth the structural durability of the whole sequence.

changed_reading.before: Certainty and striving are adjacent virtues.
changed_reading.after: Truth is longitudinal: trust stays straight through intervening reversals and continues to bear cost along a route.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The parallel بأموالهم وأنفسهم names two instruments of جاهدوا before the directional phrase في سبيل الله.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pairing inventories an outer reserve that can be possessed and an irreducible self that cannot be detached. Striving mobilizes both stores and converts held value into movement; the final truth predicate names completed conversion rather than mere sincerity of feeling.

activation_trace.role: Draining something through use, including property exhausted by giving, supplies a material conversion model for striving.
Acquired property is the detachable reserve available for transfer.
The very thing itself makes the second reserve the agent's whole identity, not merely another possession.
Precious value desired by selves explains why mobilizing the self is the costliest transfer.
The route converts depletion into directed circulation rather than waste.
Fulfillment makes mobilized reserves the performance of a prior commitment.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and lives are two examples of sacrifice.
changed_reading.after: They are a deliberate two-reserve inventory: what one has and what one is are both converted from possession into movement on God's route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger branch of deliberate pace joins prohibitions against advancing, elevating one's voice, and the positive lowering of voice. Because belief in the messenger precedes striving in 49:15, exertion becomes paced and answerable movement rather than self-authorizing acceleration.

activation_trace.role: Gentleness and deliberate pace supply a tempo latent in allegiance to the messenger.
Strained capacity is the energetic force that now requires pacing and authorization.
Forward precedence supplies the prohibited motion of outrunning God and the messenger.
Raising something supplies the prohibited vertical assertion of one's own voice.
Holding back and lowering by reduction supplies the positive discipline that channels force.
The repeated messenger reference activates deliberate pace in the immediate scene of lowered voices.

structural_cues: 49:1-3 repeatedly regulate precedence, height, and volume around the messenger.
In 49:15 allegiance to the messenger occurs before the delayed transition to striving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a messenger-associated tempo and three controls on self-assertion; I infer that these controls govern the later force of جاهدوا. A live alternative is that the opening etiquette rules and 49:15's striving remain independent domains.

changed_reading.before: Belief in the messenger and strenuous action are separate credentials.
changed_reading.after: Belief in the messenger calibrates strenuous action: truthful zeal moves at an authorized, restrained pace and cannot outrun or over-voice its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Lowering an available voice is a real expenditure of impulse, and the adjacent heart-test reveals and refines what that restraint contains. This broadens maximum effort in 49:15 to include costly inhibition, not only visible output.

activation_trace.role: Spending capacity under strain supplies the broader category into which disciplined restraint can enter.
Solidity and straightness make controlled force, not maximum display, the mark of truth.
Holding back and reducing supplies a concrete act in which capacity is spent by not discharging it.
A test that reveals what is in the heart turns restraint into diagnostic pressure.
Refinement after testing supplies a transformative result rather than mere exposure.
The pure core locates the object revealed and refined by restrained conduct.

structural_cues: 49:3 places lowered voices immediately beside tested hearts.
49:15 leaves the object of جاهدوا open while naming wealth and selves as instruments.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reduction of voice, testing, and heart; I infer that voluntary inhibition is one form of strained self-expenditure. The alternative is that voice etiquette only evidences piety and does not expand the semantic range of striving.

changed_reading.before: Striving primarily means force projected outward.
changed_reading.after: Striving can also consume capacity inwardly: withholding an available impulse under pressure may be the action that reveals and refines a truthful heart.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes an arriving report from the work of making it clear, while later separating corrosive suspicion from covert investigation. Therefore لم يرتابوا cannot simply reward untested acceptance; it names trust that refuses anxious destabilization while retaining disciplined verification.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies confidence, but not yet the method by which reports are handled.
Disturbing suspicion identifies the corrosive state negated by the focus clause.
Clarifying meaning through statement or sign supplies an active verification procedure.
A report arriving and being conveyed supplies the uncertain input that must be tested rather than absorbed.
Doubt and imagining supply the ungrounded cognition from which believers are told to keep distance.
Bad suspicion of people identifies the socially destructive specialization of that cognition.
Secret tracking of reports marks the opposite excess: verification must not become invasive surveillance.

structural_cues: 49:6 commands clarification before action on a report because error harms a people.
49:12 prohibits both much suspicion and covert investigation, placing epistemic limits on opposite sides.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies report, clarification, suspicion, and spying as a bounded sequence; I infer that non-doubt in 49:15 is stable, disciplined trust rather than incuriosity. A live alternative is that the focus clause concerns only doubt about God while the context rules concern other people.

changed_reading.before: True believers never question and accept without hesitation.
changed_reading.after: True believers are not credulous: they verify incoming claims, refuse corrosive suspicion, and do not let either uncertainty or surveillance displace settled trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: Faith's attraction and beauty are given to the heart as favor, and 49:17 reverses the believers' attempted direction of benefaction by naming divine guidance to faith. The exertion of 49:15 thus fulfills a received orientation; it cannot become an invoice presented to God.

activation_trace.role: Costly exertion supplies the achievement most liable to be misread as self-originating merit.
Fulfillment in action lets deeds confirm a prior gift without turning them into its cause.
Love lodged in the heart supplies an attraction to faith that the subjects do not manufacture in this scene.
Making something appear beautiful supplies a prior shaping of inward desire.
Benefaction and gift classify that inward shaping as received surplus.
Burdening a recipient by rehearsing one's favor supplies the rejected accounting model.
Gentle indication toward the true road supplies the reversed, divine direction of benefit.
The repeated fulfillment branch directly makes truthful action the test of whether guided faith has been realized.

structural_cues: 49:7-8 attributes faith's attractiveness to God and names it favor and gift.
49:17 rejects a claimed favor toward the messenger, reverses the favor toward divine guidance, and repeats the truth condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attraction, adornment, gift, rejected boasting, and guidance; I infer causal priority for received orientation over human expenditure. Human effort may still coexist as a real response rather than being reduced to passivity.

changed_reading.before: Costly striving earns or establishes the believer's claim to status.
changed_reading.after: Costly striving verifies a gifted orientation but cannot indebt God; truth includes refusing to convert one's response into leverage or self-congratulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two parties can be called believers and brothers while mutually fighting and requiring repair. Against that local usage, إنما المؤمنون in 49:15 reads less like cancellation of every defective member and more like naming the realized, truth-bearing performance of the identity.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies the identity whose fully realized form the focus ayah describes.
Fulfillment in action makes الصادقون an achievement predicate rather than merely a second group label.
Believer naming remains attached to the two parties before their conduct has been repaired.
Mutual combat supplies severe conduct that coexists with the contextual believer designation.
Removing estrangement supplies a repair path internal to the named community.
The repeated المؤمنون designation preserves a trust-bearing communal frame after conflict.
Brotherhood and kinship keep defective parties inside a relation that can be restored.

structural_cues: 49:9 grammatically labels both fighting parties as believers before commanding correction.
49:10 restates المؤمنون with إنما yet predicates brotherhood and repair rather than the 49:15 sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies broad believer naming amid grave failure and a repair command; I infer that 49:15 intensifies the truth of the name rather than furnishing an exhaustive social exclusion test. The alternative is a deliberate distinction between a broad legal category in 49:9-10 and a strict ontological category in 49:15.

changed_reading.before: إنما draws a Boolean boundary: anyone missing a listed trait is simply outside the believer category.
changed_reading.after: إنما profiles realized fidelity: conflicted believers can remain repairable siblings, while 49:15 names those whose assent has become fully correspondent action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reflexive أنفسكم in a prohibition on attacking other members, read beside brotherhood as a binding tie, makes selfhood socially distributed. The أنفسهم spent in 49:15 can therefore include the relational self whose dignity, bonds, and repair are put into God's way, alongside the individual life.

activation_trace.role: The very self or whole identity supplies an anchor broad enough to carry personal and relational identity.
Capacity spent under strain supplies the cost of maintaining and repairing a shared self.
A binding tie supplies the relation through which distinct people can be treated as one another's self.
Faulting by attack supplies the interpersonal act expressed reflexively as injury to yourselves.
The same whole-self branch in أنفسكم lets harm to another member rebound as harm to the collective self.

structural_cues: 49:11 uses a plural reflexive object for an interpersonal prohibition.
49:10 has already bound the believers as siblings requiring mutual repair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reflexive grammar and a brotherly bond; I infer a distributed communal self that can be spent and protected. The live alternative is that أنفسكم is only an idiom for one another and should not reshape أنفسهم in 49:15.

changed_reading.before: Their selves means each believer's private body or life.
changed_reading.after: Their selves can coexist as individual lives and a shared relational identity, so costly striving includes protecting, repairing, and refusing to wound the communal self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context images humanity as branches that both divide and join, groups facing one another, and recognition produced from marks. This can activate سبيل الله as social infrastructure: wealth and whole selves are spent to make difference traversable and mutual knowledge possible.

activation_trace.role: An extended traversed way supplies the connective infrastructure of the reading.
Possessed resources supply the material that can build and maintain a social route.
Whole identity supplies the personal exposure required to cross inherited group boundaries.
Branching and separation supply the plurality that a route must cross.
Joining and mending a split supplies the coexistence of differentiation with reconnection.
A group whose parts face one another supplies reciprocal orientation rather than isolated identity.
Recognition by sign supplies the social result toward which the route is directed.

structural_cues: 49:13 gives differentiation into peoples and tribes the stated purpose of mutual recognition.
49:15 directs both property and whole selves into a way rather than naming an object to be defeated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies branching groups, reciprocal facing, recognition, and a traversed way; I infer that one possible work of the way is building passage across social divisions. The alternative is that 49:13 only supplies a ranking ethic and leaves the concrete content of striving unspecified.

changed_reading.before: God's way is an already given arena into which resources are expended.
changed_reading.after: God's way can also be made socially traversable: resources and identity become infrastructure for recognition across branches that remain distinct.

context_deltas.mechanism: 49:14 separates spoken self-description from faith's entry into the heart and leaves obedience possible during that unfinished ingress. Read back into 49:15, the clauses form a flow from assent installed in the core, through stabilized non-doubt, into outward expenditure, with truth naming successful transmission across the whole path.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies the content that must become inwardly installed rather than merely pronounced.
Absence of disturbing suspicion marks stabilization after ingress.
Fulfillment makes the endpoint correspondence between inner installation and outward conduct.
Produced speech supplies the external claim that can precede the inward state.
Repeated assent language supplies the disputed state whose location matters.
Entering an interior supplies the directional movement from claim into core.
The pure inner core supplies the destination of faith's ingress.
Compliant obedience supplies outward movement that can begin while inward formation remains incomplete.

structural_cues: 49:14 explicitly contrasts a spoken perfect claim with faith not yet having entered the hearts.
49:15 orders assent, stabilization, expenditure, and truth as successive clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an outside-inside contrast and an ordered focus sequence; I infer a transmission model from speech through core to conduct. A live alternative is that 49:14 describes stages of distinct people while 49:15 simply lists simultaneous traits.

changed_reading.before: 49:15 supplies a static checklist for identifying believers.
changed_reading.after: 49:15 maps a successful ingress-and-outflow process: assent reaches the core, stabilizes there, and exits as costly conduct whose correspondence is called truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing context rejects informing God about one's religion, spans the hidden heavens and earth, and joins inward sight to performed work. The truth predicate of 49:15 is therefore not self-certification or reputation but correspondence between hidden orientation and visible action under a witness who accesses both.

activation_trace.role: Hidden thought and intent supply the inward side of the correspondence being judged.
Correspondence of speech with inward belief and reported reality supplies the truth relation.
Fulfillment in action supplies the visible side that confirms inward orientation.
Disclosure to the knower makes attempted self-report informationally redundant.
Obedience and submission supply the claimed religious state that speakers cannot certify for God.
What is concealed from eyes supplies the domain unavailable to communal reputation.
Insight of the heart supplies penetration beyond external display.
Intentional work supplies the observable output joined to hidden intent.

structural_cues: 49:16 immediately challenges the attempt to tell God the state of one's religion.
49:18 closes the sequence by pairing knowledge of the unseen with sight of what people do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rejected self-report, hidden knowledge, inward sight, and performed work; I infer that these establish the evaluator and two sides of صدق. The alternative is that omniscience only warns or reassures and does not define the mechanism of the focus predicate.

changed_reading.before: The final label reports a status recognizable from the community's visible checklist.
changed_reading.after: The final label is a correspondence verdict no claimant can issue for oneself: hidden intent and visible expenditure agree under comprehensive knowledge and sight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a place-image of جهد under a verbal occurrence. It remains anchored by جاهدوا, the explicit path construction, and the solidity branch of صدق; downstream prose should present exposed ground as a spatial metaphor for accountable action, not as the lexical gloss of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جاهدوا at word 10 stands beside في سبيل at word 14 and culminates in الصادقون at word 18.

activation_trace.role: Hard exposed ground spatializes effort as leaving shelter for an open testing surface.
The traversed way joins the exposed surface into a coherent spatial scene.
Solidity and straightness make truth what remains load-bearing on exposed ground.

changed_reading.before: Profession and sacrifice can be assessed as discrete credentials.
changed_reading.after: The ayah can image truth as leaving sheltered profession for exposed ground, where a straight, load-bearing commitment becomes publicly testable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because نفس as exhaled breath is distant from the ordinary plural-self construction. It remains anchored in أنفسهم and is activated by the context's regulation of audible voice; downstream prose should say that breath imagery flickers beneath embodied self-expenditure, not replace selves with breaths.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أنفسهم at word 12 is an instrument of جاهدوا, while الصادقون can carry truth in speech as well as fulfillment.

activation_trace.role: Breath leaving the body gives self-expenditure an embodied respiratory register.
Capacity spent under strain turns breath into a finite bodily budget.
Truth in speech links the bodily budget to the utterance it powers.
Audible sound supplies the context in which breath becomes socially consequential output.
Lowering by holding back supplies governance of that output rather than mere silence.

changed_reading.before: Spending the self primarily evokes risking one's body or life.
changed_reading.after: A bodily undertone appears: truthful effort governs a finite breath budget, knowing when to spend voice and when restraint itself spends the self.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because it chains peripheral material branches of سبيل and نفس into an ecological scene. The chain remains focus-rooted and the sky-earth frame in 49:18 closes its vertical geometry; downstream prose should retain it only as an image of circulating provision, never as a replacement meaning for سبيل الله.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Wealth and selves are drained into سبيل الله, whose focus inventory includes downward rain and the extended ear of grain.

activation_trace.role: Draining property by use or giving supplies release from storage into circulation.
Life-sustaining water makes the self one of the provisions that keeps life standing.
Falling rain turns the way into a downward channel of released provision.
The extended ear of grain supplies the growth produced after provision reaches receptive ground.
The sky as what rises and overshadows supplies the upper source of the vertical scene.
Soft fertile earth supplies the receiving surface on which released provision can grow.

changed_reading.before: Resources disappear as the cost of travel on an abstract divine path.
changed_reading.after: An ecological image coexists: held value is released like rain into a life-bearing channel and reappears as growth rather than simply vanishing.

strongest_changes: لم يرتابوا became disciplined, non-credulous stability bounded by verification on one side and suspicion or spying on the other.
The conflicted believers and brotherhood of 49:9-10 changed إنما from a simple exclusion test into a profile of fully realized fidelity.
The gift-and-guidance reversal of 49:7-8 and 49:17 made costly action confirmation of received orientation rather than leverage over God.
49:14 and 49:16-18 turned the focus sequence into correspondence between inward installation and visible action under comprehensive knowledge.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah supported several coexisting mechanisms: a cost-bearing verification circuit, durability across reversals, a two-reserve conversion, authorized and restrained force, distributed selfhood, and a route of mutual recognition. Peripheral branches also preserved exposed-ground, breath, and ecological images without promoting them to lexical replacements.
remaining_uncertainties: إنما may still distinguish a stricter category from the broader social use of believers rather than only intensifying one identity.
The distributed-self and mutual-recognition readings depend on carrying nearby reflexive and social structures back into the focus ayah.
The exposed-ground, breath, and ecological outliers are branch-anchored but remain metaphorical and should not be rendered as direct glosses.
